title: Keep triage issue text away from tokens (#4747)
description: The old claude-triage.yml ran the model in one job holding id-token:write and the OAuth secret next to untrusted issue text. The fix splits it three ways: a read-only fetch+sanitize job, a model job on the sanitized artifact with no id-token, and an issues:write comment job that never sees the issue. Inspect each job's reads vs holds, and try the sanitizer on an injected issue body.
